reader.requirement: At --std 85 a REWRITE on an indexed (mass storage) file must execute only when the file is open in the I-O mode; when it is not open, or open INPUT, OUTPUT or EXTEND, the statement is unsuccessful with I-O status 49 (§1985:IX.1.3.4 logic error h), the record is not replaced, and the applicable USE procedure runs.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility: at 85 no file sharing, so RewriteShared's lock arms are inert; the open-mode guard itself is not edition-gated
ctx.ExceptionPhrases.Require: the COBOL-85 mandatory INVALID KEY phrase (SR3, a different rule); not on the GR1 path

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect over Runtime/IO; MutationOpenModeGuard and IndexedConnector.Rewrite's first line consult no edition: the I-O-mode check is the same code at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses are OPEN/RELEASE cases; none exercises REWRITE on an indexed file open INPUT, OUTPUT, EXTEND or closed

probes.printed: USE OUTPUT FS=49 / USE CLOSED FS=49 / USE INPUT FS=49 / READ K001ORIGNL / AFTER I-O FS=00 / READ K001IOCHGD
probes.expected: status 49 and record not replaced in every mode but I-O; I-O REWRITE succeeds (§1985:IX.4.6.4 GR1, §1985:IX.1.3.4)

probes.printed: USE EXTEND FS=49 / USE I-O-NOREAD FS=43 / READ 08 3 / AFTER I-O FS=00 / READ 10 K0015BBBBB
probes.expected: EXTEND REWRITE 49; sequential-access I-O REWRITE without READ 43 (GR2); varying-length record replaced at its new length after READ

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.6.4 GR1  (4.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1
OK  §1985:IX.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.5h

reader.notes: The open-mode precondition is written once in FileConnector.MutationOpenModeGuard and is the first line of IndexedConnector.Rewrite; it answers '49' before any record is identified. Indexed files are mass storage by definition, so the mass-storage half needs no check. Probed through a USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR/EXCEPTION declarative and FILE STATUS.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-189/rw3.cob (ACCESS RANDOM, which the reader did not try; USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR, FILE STATUS) at --std 85 printed: OPEN OUTPUT then REWRITE ... FROM WS-REC with INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY -> USE FS=49, neither phrase taken; OPEN INPUT with a key absent from the file -> 49 (not 23: the open-mode check comes first); OPEN I-O then CLOSE then REWRITE -> 49; the statement after a FAILED OPEN I-O of a missing non-OPTIONAL file (FS2=35) -> REWRITE gives FS2=49 through USE; OPEN I-O random REWRITE -> 00 and READ shows K001RNDCHG. With the reader's DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL probes (OUTPUT, closed, INPUT, EXTEND) every mode but I-O is refused with 49 and the record is unchanged. cite.py: OK  §1985:IX.4.6.4 GR1  (4.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1.
